findings.problem:
The tail of the proof has several bookkeeping steps that add nothing:
(1) `have : QuasiIso f₀ := inferInstance` and `have : QuasiIso g₀ := inferInstance` (lines 23–24) restate instances. `quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology` already provides them, and the `[QuasiIso f] [QuasiIso g]` arguments of `VectorComplex.totalMap_quasiIso` would find them anyway.
(2) `have h := scalarForgetTotalIso_naturality k A B f g` (line 26) is used only once, in `rw [← h]`.
(3) Lines 31–33 restate the full morphism `Φ.map (mapBifunctorMap f g …)` a second time. They then apply `.mp inferInstance` to the iff `quasiIso_iff_comp_left`. Mathlib already has the one-directional lemma `quasiIso_of_comp_left`, which does exactly this: given an isomorphism `φ` and a quasi-isomorphism `φ ≫ φ'`, it concludes `QuasiIso φ'`.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace lines 23–34 with:
```lean
  have : QuasiIso t := VectorComplex.totalMap_quasiIso k _ f₀ g₀
  have : QuasiIso ((scalarForgetTotalIso k A B P Q).hom ≫
      Φ.map (mapBifunctorMap f g (bifunctor k A B) (ComplexShape.down ℕ))) := by
    rw [← scalarForgetTotalIso_naturality]
    infer_instance
  have := quasiIso_of_comp_left (scalarForgetTotalIso k A B P Q).hom
    (Φ.map (mapBifunctorMap f g (bifunctor k A B) (ComplexShape.down ℕ)))
  exact (quasiIso_map_iff_of_preservesHomology _ (forgetField k (A ⊗[k] B))).mp this
```
This has not been compiled. If needed, keep `scalarForgetTotalIso_naturality k A B f g` with explicit arguments inside the `rw`.
findings.benefit: The proof keeps its steps in the same order: Künneth for vector spaces, the naturality square, cancelling the isomorphism, and reflecting along the forgetful functor. It loses two instance restatements and a single-use name. The cancellation step now uses a lemma whose name says what it does (`quasiIso_of_comp_left`) instead of `(…iff…).mp inferInstance`. The final `exact` names the hypothesis it uses (`this`) instead of relying on an anonymous `inferInstance`. Each remaining line carries one mathematical step, so the argument is at least as easy to follow.
